data_note: layout = 'Official block map': outline read from the official FDA City block map and registered to the real streets. layout = 'Generated in the street block': the print does not resolve single plots there, the street block is split into plots of the official size. built and dev_class come from building footprints detected on satellite imagery; plot numbers, status and storeys are sample values.
